description.value: Walmart Supercenter at Hillside Mall in Victoria is a large-format retail store offering full grocery, electronics, clothing, toys, furniture, and baby departments. As a Supercenter format, it stocks a wide range of food staples and household supplies that touring cyclists can use to resupply. It is one of the most comprehensive one-stop shops available to cyclists passing through the Victoria area.
